Definition: a lot (as by means of a broken piece)
BiblicalUsage: Pur or Purim = "lot" or "piece"; 1) lot; 1a) a special feast among the post-exilic Jews, to celebrate their deliverance from Haman's destruction through queen Esther's heroic actions
